rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A SQL Server MCP server that provides secure, read-only database access through specialized tools for SQL query execution, schema inspection, performance analysis, and database monitoring. The implementation features comprehensive security validation, audit logging, multi-database support with AWS SSM integration, and specialized services for analyzing execution plans, index usage, blocking sessions, deadlocks, and SQL Agent jobs. Built with a layered architecture using FastMCP, pyodbc, and pydantic-settings, it includes Docker deployment support and extensive test coverage.
